div.l: But fyrst I you praye of your curtesye
That ye ne arette it not my vylonye
Though that I playnly speke in thys matere
To telle you here wordys and hyr chere
And though I speke here wordys propyrly
For thys ye knowe as wel as I
Who shal a tale telle after a man
He moste reherse as nere as he can
Euery word yf it be in hys charge
Al speke he neuer so rudely and so large
Or ellys he muste telle hys tale vntrewe
Or see thyngis or feyne wordis newe
He may not spare al thouh he were his broder
He moot as wel say o word as another
Cryst spak hym self ful brode in holy wryt
And well ye woot no vylany is it
Eke plato sayth who so can it rede
The word muste be cosyn to the dede
Also I pray you foryeue it me
Al though I sette not folk in her degre
Here in thyse tales as they shold stonde
My wyt is short ye may wel vnderstonde
